summary: Betterware de México (BeFra) filed a 6-K reporting its Q2 2026 results, which include the successful incorporation of Tupperware's Latin America operations. The acquisition contributed one month of results, representing 10.8% of consolidated revenue and nearly 16% of EBITDA. Net debt-to-EBITDA stood at 2.6x actual and 1.6x pro forma including Tupperware's full-year EBITDA. The board approved the acquisition, though specific terms like price per share or premium were not disclosed. The deal strengthens BeFra's portfolio in Mexico and Brazil. Watch for integration progress, synergy realization, and deleveraging pace.
